159682.name: Chabad Gan of Greenwich Preschool
159682.note: The Chabad Chinuch Office's Directory of Chabad Educational Institutions (2023-24): 'Gan of Greenwich, 75 Mason St. Greenwich CT, 06830, Director: Mrs. Maryashie Deren, Co-Ed, 18m - 4Yr ... Founded: 2002'; the 2011-12 early-childhood, 2012-13 and 2019-20 editions also give 2002. A directory's year, so medium; it fits its chabad.org listing (Aug 2004) and its own site's 'over 20 years'. Its chabad.org listing went up 2004-08-11, so it existed by then. Director: Maryashie Deren.

117625.name: New England Hebrew Academy
117625.note: The Chabad Chinuch Office's Directory of Chabad Educational Institutions (2023-24): 'New England Hebrew Academy, 9 Prescott St. Brookline, MA. 02446 ... Founded: 1944' (its preschool and its elementary entries; the 2011-12 and 2012-13 editions also give 1944). A directory's year, so medium. Was 1947 (the IRS ruling, low), which came after. Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then. The IRS recognized 'New England Hebrew Academy' (Brookline, 9 Prescott St) from 1947-12 (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer). Director: Chaim Ciment. IRS exempt-organization record (EO Business Master File, Nov 2026): 'NEW ENGLAND HEBREW ACADEMY' (EIN 04-2105882), 9 Prescott St, Brookline, ruling Dec 1947. A filing, a later bound.

117629.name: Shaloh House
117629.note: The Chabad Chinuch Office's Directory of Chabad Educational Institutions (2023-24): 'Shaloh House Hebrew Day School, 29 Chestnut Hill Ave. Boston MA, 02135, Director: Rabbi D. Rodkin ... Founded: 1967' (also its preschool there, and the 2012-13 edition: 'Founded 1967, K-7'). A directory's year, so medium; it fits CrownHeights.info's 'founded in the late 1960s' (2024). Was 1976 (the IRS ruling, low), which came after. Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then. CrownHeights.info, 24 July 2024: 'Shaloh House is a Chabad-Lubavitch institution founded in the late 1960s' (https://crownheights.info/chabad-news/874679/girls-from-rocket-torn-sderot-find-solace-at-boston-summer-camp/); not checked further. Director: Dan Rodkin. IRS exempt-organization record (EO Business Master File, Nov 2026): 'SHALOH SCHOOL OHOLEI TORAH' (EIN 04-2319172), 29 Chestnut Hill Ave, Brighton, ruling July 1976. A filing, a later bound.

119717.name: Lubavitch Pre-School
119717.note: No founding year found yet (Nov 9: first pass only: CrownHeights.info and lubavitch.com searched by name and director, and a web search for the older centres; not dug into yet). Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then. Director: Esther Ciment. The Chinuch Office's 2023-24 directory lists New England Hebrew Academy's preschool (9 Prescott St; administrator Mrs. Esther Ciment, this listing's director; 'Co-Ed, Preschool/2Yr- Kindergarten/5Yr') with 'Founded: 1944', the academy's own year; when the preschool at 11 Essex St began is not stated, so 1944 is not taken.

120024.name: Lubavitch Yeshiva Girls School
120024.note: No founding year found yet (Nov 9: CrownHeights.info and lubavitch.com searched by name and director, web search). Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then. Director: Yisroel Rosenfeld. The Chinuch Office's directories list 'Yeshiva Schools- Girls & The Early Learning Center, 6401 Forbes Ave.' with 'Founded: 1943' (2019-20; the 2012-13 edition's Girls' Division likewise), the year the Yeshiva Schools became a full-day school; the building was the Hebrew Institute's (opened 1943) before the girls' school moved in. When the girls' school itself began is not stated, so 1943 is not taken.
